      IV. KESEHATAN/HEALTH


                        PENJELASAN TEKNIS                                                          TECHNICAL NOTES
1. Keluhan kesehatan adalah keadaan seseorang yang mengalami             1. Health complaints is the condition of a person experiencing
   gangguan kesehatan atau kejiwaan, baik karena gangguan/penyakit          health or psychiatric disorders, either because of
   yang sering dialami penduduk seperti panas, pilek, diare, pusing,        disorders/diseases that are often experienced by people, such as
   sakit kepala, maupun karena penyakit akut, penyakit kronis        o. id  fever, cold, diarrhea, dizziness, headache, or because of acute
   (meskipun selama sebulan terakhir tidak mempunyai keluhan),              illness, chronic disease (although during the past month did not
   kecelakaan, kriminalitas, atau keluhan lainnya.           ps             have any complaints), accidents, crimes, or other complaints.

2. Sakit adalah mempunyai keluhan kesehatan yang menyebabkan
                                                               .g        2. Sick is health complaints that interfere with work, school, or daily
                                                         .b
   terganggunya pekerjaan, sekolah, atau kegiatan sehari-hari.              activities.
                                                     ar
3. Rawat jalan adalah upaya anggota rumah tangga yang mempunyai          3. Outpatient care is an effort by household members with health
                                                ab
   keluhan kesehatan untuk memeriksakan diri dan mendapatkan                complaints to check themselves and get treatment by visiting
                                             //j
   pengobatan dengan mendatangi tempat-tempat pelayanan                     modern or traditional health service facilities without staying
                                         s:
   kesehatan modern atau tradisional tanpa menginap, termasuk               overnight, including bringing health workers to the homes.
                                  ht
   mendatangkan petugas kesehatan ke rumah anggota rumah tangga.
                                     tp
4. Jaminan kesehatan adalah jaminan berupa perlindungan kesehatan        4. Health insurance is insurance in the form of health protection, so
    agar peserta yang telah membayar iuran atau iurannya dibayar oleh       the participants who have paid contributions or whose
    pemerintah memperoleh manfaat pemeliharaan kesehatan dan                contributions have been paid by the government receive health
    perlindungan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan dasar kesehatan.                  care and protection benefits in meeting basic health needs.

5. Rawat inap adalah upaya penyembuhan keluhan kesehatan dengan          5. Inpatient care is an effort to cure health complaints by staying one
   menginap satu malam atau lebih di unit pelayanan kesehatan               night or more in the modern or traditional health care facilities,
   modern atau tradisional, termasuk rawat inap untuk persalinan.           including inpatient for childbirth.

6. Merokok tembakau adalah aktivitas membakar tembakau kemudian          6. Smoking tobacco is an activity to burn tobacco and then inhale the
   menghisap asapnya, baik menggunakan rokok maupun pipa.                   smoke, using either cigarettes or pipes.

7. Imunisasi adalah suatu upaya untuk menimbulkan/meningkatkan           7. Immunization is an attempt to actively raise/increase a person’s
    kekebalan seseorang secara aktif terhadap suatu penyakit sehingga       immunity to a disease so that if one day they are exposed to the
    bila suatu saat terpajan dengan penyakit tersebut tidak akan sakit      disease, they will not get sick or only experience mild pain. Children

series.name: Life expectancy at birth (LFSP2020 basis)
series.concept: Expected years of life under official mortality schedule, not IPM aggregate.

source.title: Indeks Pembangunan Manusia Provinsi Jawa Barat 2023
source.table: Appendix2: Usia Harapan Hidup (UHH) Menurut Kabupaten/Kota Tahun2020–2023,2023 column, printed72

numerator.definition: Not a simple case numerator. Official life-table mortality schedule/model; no new CIVX calculation.

denominator.definition: Not general-population division. Synthetic life-table cohort at birth; LFSP2020-based BPS method.

series.formula: Official published estimate, no CIVX derivation.
series.direction: Higher years imply lower broad mortality-related health pressure.
series.detectionBias: Official demographic estimate, not healthcare screening/notification intensity. Modeling, mortality-data quality and limited short-term responsiveness remain.
caveats: LFSP2020 basis updated series must not be mixed with SP2010-based UHH.
IPM contains UHH as a component. Production still has IPM; this recommendation only applies to a next model that follows the prior audit and removes aggregate IPM.
A 2023 estimate is not an observed2023 mortality cohort or real-time outbreak measure.
Narrow absolute spread is not a reason to inflate small differences or claim exact ranks. No district CI published in this appendix.
series.uncertainty: District CIs not published in acquired official appendix; do not infer statistical significance of small differences.

recommendation.reason: Broad long-run health outcome,27 complete2023 estimates. Use standalone only in proposed HDI-free next methodology; do not add beside production IPM.

series.name: Activity-limiting morbidity in previous month
series.concept: Residents with self-reported health complaints disrupting work, school or daily activities; March2023 Susenas reference month.

source.title: Statistik Kesejahteraan Rakyat Provinsi Jawa Barat 2023

numerator.definition: Survey-weighted residents reporting complaints that interfered with usual activities during month before interview.

denominator.definition: All survey-weighted residents represented by Susenas March2023, not only clinic users or complainants.

series.formula: Published survey-weighted percent; no division by unrelated administrative population.
series.direction: Higher means more reported activity-limiting illness in survey reference month.
series.detectionBias: Self/proxy reporting, symptom awareness, age structure and recall differ; not chiefly screening intensity. This limitation is explicitly accepted for the literal functional outcome.
caveats: Not diagnosed disease prevalence, yearly incidence, or disease-specific burden.
Reference month before March2023 interview, not whole-calendar2023 average.
Do not age-standardize without official age-specific data; age composition can differ.
Survey precision limits ranks; do not convert rounded percentages to integer case counts.
series.uncertainty: Published standard errors, relative standard errors and95% confidence intervals retained for all27; complex survey. No independence or binomial-SE assumption.

recommendation.reason: Comparable population survey outcome, not service-use count;27/27 numeric values with published district precision. Distinct short-term functional morbidity beside long-run survival.

denominator.definition: All survey-weighted residents represented by Susenas March2023, not only clinic users or complainants.

series.direction: Higher means more reported complaints, not necessarily more objectively diagnosed disease.
